treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and Romania for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2003)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 50. | Romania | 06.02.1998 | 23.10.2003 | 26.10.2005 ( est/eng ) | 29.11.2005 | 01.01.2006 |

rates.quote: the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notifications (25.11.2021, 01.06.2022) do not include this treaty, so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet effect.

notes: Royalties are in Article 13 (Article 12 covers commission: source-State cap 2% on commissions paid to brokers/commission agents - not modelled). Single 10% dividend rate (no participation tier). Interest exempt at source for Government (incl. local authorities/administrative-territorial units), Central Bank, wholly-owned financial institutions and government-guaranteed loans (Art. 11(3)). No protocol.
